purpose: Teach: 奴ら/巷/傍ら/導き/綴っ/無けれ/しかり/情景

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは奴らという言葉を使われなかった
lines.en: You know, Gran, when your father was young, he never used words to dismiss people like that.
lines.style: Soft, reflective opening. Voice catches slightly on the memory. Slow, deliberate pacing. A question posed to the past as much as to her.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、巷の噂に惑わされない方だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: That's right. Your grandfather—he wasn't one to be swayed by what people said in town, was he?
lines.style: Warm affirmation, nodding slightly in her voice. Gentle confirmation of shared memory. A little lift at the end, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、私の傍らで日記を読んで下さった
lines.en: When I was young, he used to read his diary to me, sitting right beside me.
lines.style: Quieter now, voice full of gratitude. Pauses between phrases like he's seeing it again. Tender but not sentimental.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様の導きを大切にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He cherished guiding his grandchildren, didn't he? That was always so clear.
lines.style: Affirming, almost lyrical. Soft but assured. She's speaking the obvious truth of a life she knew completely.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが手紙を綴って下さった
lines.en: When I was young, he wrote me letters. Such careful letters.
lines.style: Voice thickens slightly with emotion here. Held breath. Speaks slowly, as if reading the words off those letters now.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご家族が無ければ生きてけなかったって仰ったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He used to say he couldn't have lived without his family. Do you remember him saying that?
lines.style: Tender, almost protective in tone. She's quoting something sacred to her. Slight lift of certainty at the question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんの判断は今もしかり鋭い
lines.en: His judgment was sharp even then. Still sharp now, I think.
lines.style: Quiet admiration. Voice steady but tinged with melancholy—speaking of absence. A fact stated with care.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、故郷の情景をよく語って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He told such vivid stories about his hometown. Don't you remember how he'd describe it?
lines.style: Wistful, almost dreamy. She's there in those stories with him. Fades gently on the question, inviting him to return to them too.
